scripts.lint: npm run lint:prettier && npm run lint:eslint
scripts.test: echo '🧪 Running all tests...' && npm run test:rust && npm run test:jest && npm run test:wasm:wrappers && echo '✅ All tests passed!'
scripts.test:rust:security: echo '🔐 Testing security-critical components...' && npm run test:rust:crypto && npm run test:rust:keys && npm run test:rust:x3dh
scripts.test:rust:coverage: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cargo tarpaulin --out Html --output-dir coverage-rust
scripts.test:wasm:wrappers: npm run build:wasm:node && node test-wasm-standalone.mjs && echo '✅ WASM module verified' || exit 1
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:rust:quick && npm run test:jest
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:rust:coverage && npm run test:jest -- --coverage
scripts.build: npm run build:reset && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:storybook
scripts.build:wasm: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ./pkg && cp -r ./pkg ./Frontend/pkg && rm -f ./Frontend/pkg/.gitignore
scripts.build:wasm:quick: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg && echo '✅ WASM built to pkg/'
scripts.build:wasm:production: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir pkg && echo '✅ Production WASM built'
scripts.build:wasm:dev: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && wasm-pack build --dev --target web --out-dir pkg
scripts.build:wasm:node: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node
scripts.build:wasm:bundler: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir pkg-bundler
scripts.build:wasm:all-targets: npm run build:wasm:production && npm run build:wasm:node && npm run build:wasm:bundler && echo '✅ All WASM targets built'
scripts.build:wasm:with-security-fixes: echo '🔐 Building WASM with security fixes (real X25519, Ed25519)...' && npm run build:wasm:production && npm run validate:wasm
scripts.validate:wasm: test -f pkg/signal_protocol_wasm_bg.wasm && echo '✅ WASM file exists' || echo '❌ WASM build failed'
scripts.validate:wasm:size: ls -lh pkg/signal_protocol_wasm_bg.wasm 2>/dev/null || echo '❌ WASM not found'
scripts.status:wasm:
echo '📊 WASM Status:' && ls -lh pkg/signal_protocol_wasm_bg.wasm 2>/dev/null && echo '
📅 Last modified:' && stat -c '%y' pkg/signal_protocol_wasm_bg.wasm 2>/dev/null || echo '❌ WASM not built yet'
scripts.check:crypto-implementation: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cargo check --lib && echo '✅ Rust crypto implementation valid'
scripts.info:security-changes:
echo '
🔐 Security Changes:
- Real X25519 ECDH (was: fake SHA-256)
- Real Ed25519 signatures (was: HMAC)
- No secret logging (was: all secrets in logs)
- Production-ready crypto libraries

Rebuild WASM: npm run build:wasm:with-security-fixes'
scripts.deploy:p2p: npm run build:wasm:production && cp -r pkg/* ../p2p/node_modules/cryptography/pkg/ 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ Deployed to p2p' || echo '⚠️  p2p not found - manual deploy needed'
scripts.build:storybook: storybook build && cp -r pkg storybook-static/ && cp -r storybook-static/* ./Frontend && rm -f ./Frontend/pkg/.gitignore
scripts.setup-rust: npm run install-rust && npm run install-wasm-pack
scripts.verify: echo '🔐 Running all formal verifications...' && npm run verify:fstar:lite && npm run verify:rocq:lite && echo '✅ All verifications passed!'
scripts.verify:fstar: cd signal-protocol-core/proofs/fstar/extraction && eval $(opam env) && PATH="$HOME/.opam/5.1.1/bin:$PATH" FSTAR_Z3_EXE=$HOME/.opam/5.1.1/bin/z3-4.13.3 make verify
scripts.verify:fstar:lite: cd signal-protocol-core/proofs/fstar/extraction && eval $(opam env) && PATH="$HOME/.opam/5.1.1/bin:$PATH" FSTAR_Z3_EXE=$HOME/.opam/5.1.1/bin/z3-4.13.3 make verify-lite
scripts.verify:fstar:clean: cd signal-protocol-core/proofs/fstar/extraction && rm -rf .cache .depend && eval $(opam env) && PATH="$HOME/.opam/5.1.1/bin:$PATH" FSTAR_Z3_EXE=$HOME/.opam/5.1.1/bin/z3-4.13.3 make verify
scripts.verify:rocq: cd signal-protocol-core/proofs/rocq/extraction && eval $(opam env) && PATH="$HOME/.opam/5.1.1/bin:$PATH" make verify
scripts.verify:rocq:lite: cd signal-protocol-core/proofs/rocq/extraction && eval $(opam env) && PATH="$HOME/.opam/5.1.1/bin:$PATH" make verify-lite
scripts.verify:rocq:clean: cd signal-protocol-core/proofs/rocq/extraction && rm -rf _CoqProject *.vo *.aux && eval $(opam env) && PATH="$HOME/.opam/5.1.1/bin:$PATH" make verify
scripts.verify:rocq:extract: cd signal-protocol-core && eval $(opam env) && cargo-hax -C --no-default-features \; into coq --z3rlimit 40
scripts.verify:setup:z3: cd /tmp && wget -q https://github.com/Z3Prover/z3/releases/download/z3-4.13.3/z3-4.13.3-x64-glibc-2.35.zip && unzip -q -o z3-4.13.3-x64-glibc-2.35.zip && cp /tmp/z3-4.13.3-x64-glibc-2.35/bin/z3 ~/.opam/5.1.1/bin/z3-4.13.3 && echo '✅ Z3 4.13.3 installed'
scripts.docker:clean: sudo docker compose down && sudo docker system prune -f
